cases.title: Cylinder in a channel, Re = 100 (statistics)
cases.description: Schäfer-Turek 2D-2 geometry, D = 20 cells, 20 s of simulated time (≈ 60 shedding periods). The vortex street is periodic from t ≈ 7 s; by then round-off differences have grown enough for the instantaneous fields of backends that are not bit-identical to differ, so the verdict uses the force statistics from t = 10 s (≈ 30 periods, ≈ 1000 samples per second): St = fD/Ū and the mean, minimum and maximum of the drag and lift.
